TrustedSigner.description: TrustedSigner is one signer and what it may sign. Its identity fields mean what they mean in Signer.

name.description: Name labels the signer in reports and messages.

roles.description: Roles is what the signer may sign: image (an image's signature and attestations; the default) and/or stack (a clearcutt-factory stack).

description: TrustPolicy says whose signatures an organization accepts, and for what. The ClearCutt tools share it: clearcutt-verify checks an estate's evidence against its image signers, and clearcutt-factory (signing.trustPolicy) checks images and stacks against it when building, publishing, and rebasing.

signers.description: Signers are the trusted signers; evidence verifies if any applicable one vouches for it.

title: ClearCutt trust policy
